data.description: Per-element half-circle SVG gauge. Animates from 0 to the supplied value when scrolled into view.

data-aed-gauge-max.description: Upper bound used to compute the percentage filled.

data-aed-gauge-size.description: Outer width in pixels (height is roughly half).

data-aed-gauge-label.description: Center label override. Defaults to the value.

data-aed-trend.description: Override accent color to signal direction or status.
